title: 8-Mode Ring First-Convergence & Hold Phase
intuition: Monitors dense first-convergence and sustained hold on an 8-mode 2D Gaussian ring (modes == 8, hq >= 0.90) using the archived K3P ConvergenceGate, producing the exact state extended by `ring_extension`.
failure_mode: Recipes that briefly hit 8/8 modes and then drift below hq=0.90 or drop a mode fail to lock in a valid hold state.
protocol_notes: Phase parent of `ring_extension` in one uninterrupted execution group; also prerequisite in Four Laws Adherence.
